swap_text: Ninguna de las respuestas anteriores es correcta.

qa_exclusions.method: Two 12-shard adversarial QA fleets (163 agents): every item read by a reviewer, every finding attacked by an independent refuter. A fleet upheld 8/54 flags, B fleet 18/85. A final broad regex sweep for meta-option answers caught 2 more (b152, b458) that both fleets and the original narrow pattern missed.

b10.evidence: 'control endoscopico de la lesion descrita' — the 15 mm adenoma is described only in b9's stem, never in the shared context

b14.evidence: 'dado el estadio y la ubicacion' — T1N0M0 is in b13, '30 cm del margen anal' is in b9; neither is present here

b16.evidence: 'seguimiento endoscopico de este paciente' — the curative pT1 resection justifying 6-month control is in b13-b15

b18.evidence: 'En este paciente' — the twelve polyps justifying high-risk referral are in b17; on the visible text, option a) is true

b19.evidence: 'el cuadro descrito' is b17's twelve sub-centimetre polyps; the vignette states there is NO family history

b202.evidence: stem asks for the single false statement about functional rectal pain; options c and d are both false

b228.evidence: 'Teniendo en cuenta su anterior respuesta' — depends on an answer the model never gave

b23.evidence: 'la entidad que afecta a esta familia' — the Lynch-like diagnosis is in b22; the vignette says 'sin antecedentes'

b408.evidence: key says 'Tos' is NOT a Zenker's symptom; chronic cough is a well-documented Zenker's symptom. Defect in the source exam key.

b152.evidence: 'Todos los anteriores son objetivos esperables...' — removing the aggregator leaves all three survivors individually true. Missed by the narrow pattern (masculine 'todos').

b188.evidence: 'Todos los anteriores' — ascites, encephalopathy and hypoglycaemia each independently indicate admission

b191.evidence: 'Todo paciente con hepatitis aguda por VHC debe recibir tratamiento antiviral' is true under current guidance

b204.evidence: 'Todas son correctas.' — indocyanine green, aminopyrine breath test etc. are each valid

b245.evidence: with 'Mama' removed, 'Melanoma' is defensibly correct; the literature is split

b257.evidence: correct answer was already 'Ninguno de las anteriores' — the swap changes nothing and tests nothing

b292.evidence: option d was already 'Ninguna es correcta.'; the swap creates two none-of-the-above options

b303.evidence: with primary sclerosing cholangitis removed, 'Cirrosis de cualquier etiologia' is itself correct

b342.evidence: 'Todas las afirmaciones anteriores son correctas.' — the exam itself certifies every survivor as true

b398.evidence: removed key was 'No recomendado como monoterapia'; a survivor is defensibly correct

b428.evidence: most frequent gastric polypoid lesion — a survivor is defensible once fundic-gland polyp is removed

b430.evidence: 'Todas las afirmaciones anteriores son correctas' — every survivor is certified true by the key

b437.evidence: 'Todas son ciertas.' — every surviving distractor is individually true

b458.evidence: correct answer was already 'Todas las anteriores son falsas.' — semantically identical to the swap string

b491.evidence: stem's bar is very low ('se han relacionado con'); survivors also qualify

b497.evidence: acute severe UC with fever after infliximab — a surviving option is also correct
